headline.missingDisposition: This task's run finished, but no next step was chosen. Choose what happens next — try the task again, mark it done, or send it for review.
headline.waitWithoutTarget: This task's last run stopped to wait, but there is no reviewer, blocker, monitor, or approval to wait for. Paperclip is repairing the next step; the task stays with its owner.
headline.strandedTask: Paperclip retried this task's last run, but there is still no queued run, reviewer, blocker, or other next owner. To get it moving, choose what happens next — try the task again, mark it done, or send it for review.
headline.workspaceValidation: Paperclip stopped this run because the task's git workspace could not be validated.

headline.activeWatchdog: The active run has been silent. Recovery is observing without interrupting it.

lineage.recoveringRun: Paperclip is recovering the existing run.
lineage.recoverBudgetExhausted: Paperclip could not recover the existing run within its retry budget. Review the recorded failure before retrying.
lineage.retryMissedStart: The retry for the existing run came due and did not start. Review the recorded failure and retry when ready.
lineage.scheduledNextAttempt: Paperclip has scheduled another attempt to resume the existing run.
lineage.needsRecovery: The existing run still needs recovery. Review the recorded failure before retrying.
lineage.autoRetryMissed: This task's automatic retry came due and did not run, so nothing is moving it forward right now. Someone must retry it or record the next step.
lineage.sourceOwnerExhausted: This task's last run stopped to wait, but nothing was waiting for it. The original owner has used every automatic repair attempt, so the next step needs a decision. The task stays with its owner.
lineage.sourceOwnerRetrying: This task's last run stopped to wait, but nothing was waiting for it. Paperclip is retrying the original owner to record a real next step. The task stays with its owner, and no action is needed yet.
lineage.recoveryOwner: The original owner could not record a next step within its retry budget. A recovery owner is now repairing the path only — the task itself still belongs to its original owner.
lineage.boardMustChoose: Automatic recovery is exhausted, so the board must choose the next step. The task itself still belongs to its original owner.

recovery.retryDidNotRun: The scheduled retry did not run — a retry or a decision is needed
recovery.retriesFinished: Automatic retries are finished — a decision is needed

breakglass.title: Break-glass reconciliation
breakglass.description: This overrides Paperclip's safety check and points the recorded workspace at the live branch {{emphasis}}. Confirm the divergence below and record why before continuing.
breakglass.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Verified the live branch carries only the intended follow-up commits; safe to adopt.

repair.trigger: Repair workspace — quarantine changes & restore branch
repair.title: Repair workspace
repair.description: This is lossless — no reason required. Your uncommitted changes are committed onto a fresh rescue branch, then the recorded branch is restored so the task can resume. The live branch is left exactly as it is.
repair.heldByIsolatedSuffix: — re-issue on an isolated workspace instead.

reissue.description: Creates a fresh copy of this task on an isolated git worktree based on the live branch. Your current workspace and its commits are left untouched.
